Animal Control
Learn about the Melrose Animal Control Department and its various responsibilities.
Assessor
The mission of the Melrose Assessment Department is to provide fiscal stability by promptly, fairly, and equitably determining the valuation of all real and personal property located in the City of Melrose.
Auditor
The overall goal of the Auditor's Office is to provide financial information useful for making economic, political, and social decisions, and to demonstrate accountability and stewardship, as well as information useful for evaluating managerial and organizational performance.
City Clerk
The City Clerk's mission is to maintain and protect these records in the best possible manner and serve the public by providing information in an efficient and timely manner.
Council on Aging
The mission of the Council on Aging is to connect older adults with programs, resources, and services in our community to generate a positive impact on daily living.
Economic Development
Melrose remains a highly desirable location for both its residents and businesses, given its density, walkability, and variety of commercial districts.
Elections
The City of Melrose Elections Office directs all Municipal, State, and Federal Elections within the City of Melrose.
Emergency Management
Melrose Emergency Management, using the guidelines of the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), facilitates planning, secures, and provides resources to help protect the residents and the business community from hazards that threaten Melrose and provides assistance.
Fire
The Fire Department protects the citizens of Melrose from the ravages of fire in the most effective manner possible and provides state-of-the-art emergency medical care.
Health & Human Services
The Melrose Health and Human Services Department promotes the personal and environmental health of the community through education and policy development supported by enforceable regulations and collaboration with other people and organizations.
Human Resources
The Human Resources Department ensures that the City of Melrose follows fair and consistent employment practices, supports employees and retirees in health and welfare benefits, complies with federal and state laws and collective bargaining agreements, and effectively communicates employment matters to all City employees.
Information Technology
The IT Department for the City of Melrose supports all municipal and school IT needs throughout the city.
Inspection Services
The Inspectional Services Department is mandated by state law and city ordinances to ensure public safety and improve the quality of life in Melrose.
Legal Department
The Legal Department for the City of Melrose provides legal representation, advice, and support to the City of Melrose and its officials, department heads, agencies, boards and commissions in numerous areas of municipal law .
Mayor
Find information about the current mayor of Melrose.
Meetings of Boards, Commissions, & Committees
Gather information on upcoming meetings of the various boards, commission, and committees.
Melrose Memorial Hall
The mission of the Soldiers and Sailors Memorial Building is to provide the city with a commemorative monument to the patriotism of service men and women from Melrose who died for their country.
Mount Hood Memorial Park & Golf Course
Mount Hood is operated and maintained under a management agreement between the City of Melrose and Mass.
Office of Planning & Community Development
It is the mission of the Office of Planning and Community Development (OPCD) to protect and enhance the quality of life in Melrose.
Park Department
The goal of the Melrose Park Department is to protect, maintain and develop the City’s parks, fields and recreational facilities for the benefit of Melrose residents.
Parking Office
Gather information on the Parking Office.
Police Department
The mission of the Melrose Police Department is to provide quality policing through collaboration and mutual trust with the citizens of our community. We will do so with honor and integrity.
Public Library
Learn about the public library of Melrose.
Public Schools
Welcome to Melrose Public Schools, where excellence in education meets a nurturing and inclusive community environment.
Public Works
The Melrose Department of Public Works provides quality services to the community in the areas of drinking water, wastewater, solid waste, recycling, parks, forestry, fleet, highway, cemetery, facilities, engineering, and administration, while promoting health, safety, sustainability, and fiscal responsibility through the teamwork and commitment of an honest and dependable workforce.
Recreation Department
Here you will find all the information you will need to get involved with one or many of the programs and or activities the Recreation Department has to offer.
Retirement Board
The Melrose Retirement System is administered by a five-member board: two elected members, two appointed members, and a member ex-Officio (City Auditor/CFO).
Treasurer / Collector’s Office
The mission of the Office of the Treasurer and Collector is to provide the city with a system of fiscally prudent monetary controls, thereby ensuring the safeguarding of the funds collected and invested for the citizens of the City.
Veterans' Services
Melrose Veterans' Services is part of the Melrose-Wakefield-Saugus (MWS) Veterans' Services District.
